# Copilot Instructions

This project is a C# WPF desktop application for designing printable labels. Users can drag and drop text, images, EAN-13/EAN-8 barcodes, and QR codes onto a label canvas. Label fields can be dynamically bound to MySQL query results. Templates are saved/loaded as XML. Print preview and printing are supported.

## Project Structure
- UI: WPF views and controls
- Models: Data models for label elements and templates
- Services: MySQL data access, barcode/QR generation, print logic
- Templates: XML template management

## Development Steps
1. Scaffold WPF project and folders
2. Implement drag-and-drop label designer
3. Add MySQL data binding
4. Integrate barcode/QR libraries
5. Implement print preview and printing
6. Save/load templates as XML

Follow best practices for WPF and C# development.
